question: In 2012, Re:Zero, The Rising of the Shield Hero, Mushoku Tensei, and KonoSuba were being posted around the same time. As each work became more famous, I'd really like to hear how you viewed one another!
answer:
I'm very conscious of them, but they aren't nearly as conscious of me! (laughs)

Around 2012, there were several works that would become a topic of conversation whenever they updated, and the four works you mentioned were among them. Around that time, we were competing with each other while updating almost every day.

We had a chat room together that we'd made back then, and we'd spend most days chatting in it between updates.

...They weren't writing with the goal of getting published, you know.

I had decided to write Re:Zero on the web because I thought a wave of web novels was coming, but they didn't have that kind of ambition. Their attitude was simply, “I'm writing because I want to write.”

These days, though, I think that's part of what makes them special. (laughs)
